terminals.name: studio-api
terminals.description: CurvStudio Python API backend. Serves fixtures/datasets, saves ground truth, and runs the compiled C++ curv_cli / hand_inspector_cli for inference. The studio-web frontend proxies /api, /data and /output to this server on port 8088.

terminals.name: studio-web
terminals.description: CurvStudio annotation frontend (Vite + React + TypeScript) on http://localhost:3000. Proxies API calls to the studio-api backend on port 8088.

terminals.name: cesium-viewer
terminals.description: Phase 4 CesiumJS 3D digital-twin viewer (Vite) on http://localhost:5173.
